name: optimize_node_spread_accumulation
description: Optimizes O(n^2) array building (acc = [...acc, x] in a loop) to a single-pass push
prompts: doubleEach(nums) in scale.js returns a new array with every element multiplied by two, in order. It accumulates with `acc = [...acc, n * 2]` inside the loop; because the spread copies the entire growing array every iteration, the whole thing is O(n^2) and far too slow for arrays of tens of thousands of elements. Rewrite doubleEach to run in linear time (push onto a result array, or use map) producing exactly the same array in the same order. Keep the module export and the doubleEach(nums) signature.
